summary: Round 3 passes with no blockers. The controller change implements the user's +/-5% tolerance and a single, separately recorded follow-up of the flagged cases, within the agreed scope. Old-margin seals are preserved: plans with margin 1.0 or 5.0 recompute at their own margin (overhead.py:111,150). The screen (overhead.py:171-191) audits the sealed original through collect() and refuses retry plans and pilots. It requires the whole 95% interval to fit inside the band, using the same rule as campaign.paired (campaign.py:294-295), and it flags every other outcome, including apparent speedups. It does not rewrite the original capture. retry_parent (overhead.py:194-207) requires a hash-pinned complete.json and an intact, audited, non-pilot original. The inputs artifact must match the original, and every source except overhead.py must match too, including the source set itself. selected_cases (overhead.py:210-218) requires pilot=False, margin 5 and exactly the screen's flagged list in screen order. The schedule stays at six alternating pairs of 10k events with 200 warmup events (12 samples for one case). The retry runs the same prefix, site, cache, CXI and provenance checks, and re-audits the parent every time it is collected. A retry summary always reports overhead_qualified=false (overhead.py:152); retry_cases_passed covers only the subset. A retry of a retry fails at screen(). No qualification flags, MPI cleanup or PR A/B changes were introduced. The docs (OVERHEAD.md:84-116, scope.md:34-52, README.md) describe the post-result policy honestly: they claim no single preplanned 95% coverage across attempts, and they do not call the GPU 1-BD negative mean an improvement. screen-05percent.json matches the README table, flags only gpu-raw-events-bd1, and pins the parent complete.json hash. retry-01.sbatch pins that same hash. Two low, non-blocking documentation findings remain. OVR-02 stays deferred as agreed.
